COR-B-4 (2026-07-16): _cancelled_tasks changed from a bare set[str] to a dict[str, float] (task_id -> cancellation monotonic timestamp). cancel_task now sweeps entries older than _CANCELLED_TASK_TTL_SECONDS (300s) on every call via _sweep_cancelled_tasks. Previously the set was only cleaned in the /synthesize finally block for a matching task_id, so a task cancelled but never synthesized (a fan-out child cancelled before its own /synthesize, or a job cancelled while still queued) left a permanent entry -- unbounded growth over uptime. _is_task_cancelled semantics unchanged within the TTL window.
